newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 169,900 MT--a marketing-year low--were off 36 percent from the previous week and 59 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases for South Korea (157,100 MT), Colombia (51,100 MT), Mexico (47,400 MT), and Indonesia (30,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (101,900 MT), Peru (37,000 MT), and the Dominican Republic (16,800 MT).
Sales of 377,300 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were primarily for Japan (199,400 MT), Mexico (70,000 MT), and Taiwan (56,000 MT).

Exports of 576,500 MT were one-tenth lower than the week earlier and the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (164,500 MT), Colombia (145,700 MT), Taiwan (56,700 MT), South Korea (54,600 MT), and Spain (43,900 MT).
